result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions. The existing `*Convention*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests or check the new patterns against sample files, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `build-gradle.js` cases are untested.

In `GeneratedConventions.java`:
- **HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `[.](html|htm|xhtml)`. The old pattern listed `html` twice and left out `htm`.
- **JavaScript:** the `// Generated by …` rule now matches `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.
- **XML:** the `<doc>` assembly-documentation rule now matches `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`.

In `BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`, the Gradle JavaScript rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so it matches `build-gradle.js`.

I only touched the file-name patterns, so the content patterns and line limits are unchanged and what matched before still matches.
